text:
jamie: kicking off marketplace entry for a hybrid listing (Hosted API + Dedicated capacity). want to align on assets, legal checklist, and packaging decisions.

sana: timeline? do we need AMIs or container images for all three clouds? :thinking_face:

jamie: target is EOW for initial submission to AWS, then staggered GCP/Azure next week. AWS needs AMI + listing metadata. GCP needs container image + pricing YAML. Azure needs VM image + offer manifest.

matt: can we reuse the same billing SKU across clouds or do we need separate SKUs per marketplace? last time we had to map SKUs per vendor.

leo: separate SKUs per cloud required. also need publisher support contact in the portal. I'll own SKU mapping.

nina: legal-ops — tagging you. we'll need the standard marketplace terms plus an addendum for Dedicated (data handling + SLA). any red flags? @legal-ops

legal-ops: saw the brief — we'll need: 1) privacy/data processing addendum, 2) SLA excerpt for dedicated, 3) third-party software notices. can you drop the draft by tomorrow?

jamie: copying a minimal asset checklist I'm proposing:

```
- AWS: AMI (us-west-2), product images (png), marketing blurb, pricing SKU, support contact
- GCP: container image (gcr), pricing YAML, screenshots, trial provisioning script
- Azure: VM image (Managed Image), offer manifest, logos, trial instructions
- All: security contact, SOC/ISO cert links, POC for onboarding
```

sana: for trial provisioning script — we should include a terraform snippet. matt can you paste the snippet you used for the sandbox?

matt: sure, quick paste:
```
provider "aws" { region = "us-west-2" }
module "rdw_trial" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/inference/marketplace-trial//modules/aws"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
}
```

leo: tagging marketplace-bot to request marketplace publisher IDs. @marketplace-bot please create ticket for publisher ID + portal access for eu and us regions.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket MKT-4123 for AWS publisher ID request. ETA 2 business days.

jamie: action items: 1) @leo -> SKU mapping (due TOM EOD) 2) @matt -> terraform + AMI bake instructions (due TOM EOD) 3) @sana -> packaging copy and screenshots (due TOM EOD) 4) @nina + @legal-ops -> DPA + SLA draft (due TOM EOD). If any of these slip, call it out here.

nina: noted. legal will aim for draft by end of day. if we need extra review cycles, ping me.

matt: AMI bake doc link (WIP): https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/ami-bake-wip — will update with build steps and Packer template.

leo: I'll set up a quick QA check-in tomorrow 10am PT to verify packaging artifacts before submit. invite sent. :calendar:

jamie: perfect. one more thing — pricing strategy: freemium trial + monthly commit for Dedicated. need input from sales later but packaging should include both a trial tag and "reserved" billing mapping.

nina: can we include a short security blurb for each listing? legal-ops will verify wording.

legal-ops: yes, please use placeholder: "Redwood Inference complies with SOC2 and ISO27001; data processed per customer DPA." we'll swap cert links when available.

sana: all good. will upload initial assets to the shared S3 bucket: s3://redwood-marketplace-assets/hybrid-listing/ by EOD.

jamie: thanks team. I'll reconvene after the 10am QA check. if anyone uncovers a blocker (license, cert, or publisher access) shout here and tag @jamie. :rocket:
